subject: planner: convert cartesian semi join with other nulleq condition to cross semi join with equal condition (#58075)
summary: Diff scope is a single planner behavior change: `LogicalJoin.ExtractOnCondition` now classifies column-to-column `<=>` (`ast.NullEQ`) as an `EqualCondition` (join key) alongside `=` instead of leaving it in `OtherConditions`, converting previously “CARTESIAN ... other cond:nulleq(...)” joins into non-cartesian joins with `equal:[nulleq(...)]`. Confirmed executor hash join supports `IsNullEQ` semantics (NULL matches NULL) and MPP/TiFlash join pushdown remains blocked for `NullEQ` equal keys via existing checks; later upstream history retains this behavior.
